import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 1 << 20;
    static int n;
    static int[] array_f = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] array_g = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] probability = new int[2 * 21][2 * 21];
    static int[][] index_map = new int[2][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] rev_mask = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] match = new int[21];
    static int[][] adj = new int[21][21];

    static int mod_pow(int base, int exp) {
        long res = 1;
        long b = base;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * b) % MOD;
            }
            b = (b * b) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) res;
    }

    static void compute(int[] f, List<Integer> left, List<Integer> right, List<Integer> subgraph, int[] idx) {
        List<int[]> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int x : left) {
            for (int y : right) {
                edges.add(new int[]{x, y});
            }
        }
        int edgesCount = edges.size();
        int totalMasks = 1 << edgesCount;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < totalMasks; mask++) {
            int prob = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < edgesCount; i++) {
                int[] edge = edges.get(i);
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    prob = (int)((long)prob * probability[edge[0]][edge[1]] % MOD);
                    adj[edge[0]][edge[1]] = 1;
                } else {
                    prob = (int)((long)prob * (MOD + 1 - probability[edge[0]][edge[1]]) % MOD);
                    adj[edge[0]][edge[1]] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int g : subgraph) {
                List<Integer> perm = new ArrayList<>(left);
                List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (((g >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                        indices.add(i + n);
                    }
                }
                boolean found = false;
                do {
                    boolean valid = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < perm.size(); i++) {
                        if (adj[perm.get(i)][indices.get(i)] == 0) {
                            valid = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (valid) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(indices));
                if (found) {
                    int mask_idx = idx[g];
                    rev_mask[mask] |= (1 << mask_idx);
                }
            }
            f[0] = (f[0] + prob) % MOD;
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> seq) {
        int i = seq.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && seq.get(i) >= seq.get(i + 1)) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = seq.size() - 1;
        while (seq.get(j) <= seq.get(i)) {
            j--;
        }
        Collections.swap(seq, i, j);
        int left = i + 1;
        int right = seq.size() - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            Collections.swap(seq, left, right);
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                probability[i][j + n] = (int)((long)val * mod_pow(100, MOD - 2) % MOD);
            }
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(probability[0][n]);
            return;
        }

        int size1 = n / 2;
        int size2 = n - size1;

        int count1 = 0, count2 = 0;
        List<Integer> subset1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> subset2 = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == size1) {
                index_map[0][mask] = count1++;
                subset1.add(mask);
            }
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == size2) {
                index_map[1][mask] = count2++;
                subset2.add(mask);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < subset2.size(); i++) {
            int mask = subset2.get(i);
            for (int big_mask = 0; big_mask < (1 << count2); big_mask++) {
                if (((big_mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    int rev_mask_idx = index_map[0][((1 << n) - 1 - mask)];
                    rev_mask[big_mask] |= (1 << rev_mask_idx);
                }
            }
        }

        List<Integer> left_part1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> left_part2 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> right_part = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = n; i < 2 * n; i++) {
            right_part.add(i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < size1; i++) {
            left_part1.add(i);
        }
        for (int i = size1; i < n; i++) {
            left_part2.add(i);
        }

        compute(array_f, left_part1, right_part, subset1, index_map[0]);
        compute(array_g, left_part2, right_part, subset2, index_map[1]);

        for (int i = 0; i < count1; i++) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << count1); mask++) {
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    array_f[mask] = (array_f[mask] + array_f[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        long total = 0;
        int full_mask = (1 << count1) - 1;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << count2); mask++) {
            int w = (1 - array_f[full_mask - rev_mask[mask]] + MOD) % MOD;
            total = (total + (long)w * array_g[mask]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
